mentions.name: KoalaMM
mentions.description: This memo app keeps indented lists flat instead of nesting them into parent-child hierarchies, letting users move lines around freely like in OneNote but with a less clunky interface.
mentions.problem: Notion, Obsidian, and most other memo apps use nested, parent-child lists; OneNote offers the preferred flat structure for freely moving lines but is clunky to use.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A memo app where indented lists stay flat instead of nesting https://koalamm.com

Notion, Obsidian, and most other memo apps use nested, parent-child lists. I love how OneNote lets you move lines around freely with a flat structure, but as you know OneNote is clunky, so I built this.
mentions.author: my12parsecs
